plan.anchors: three largest positive development category-versus-outside contrasts per profile, distinct features
plan.approval: User: did you check whether shallow decision trees can give trivial explanations to T5? proceed as you suggested
plan.assignment: nearest stored development centre; first stored centre on an exact tie; preserve cluster order
plan.distance_flag: distance exceeds assigned-profile development weighted p95; diagnostic, not exclusion
plan.eligibility: all 20 original-unit profile features observed; incomplete respondents remain unassigned
plan.interpretation: descriptive transfer under a fixed classifier; not independent re-emergence of the groups
plan.profile_ids: T5_C0,...,T5_C4; never renumber by prevalence; never substitute for prior alternative-model IDs
plan.role: approved primary candidate; assess transfer before downstream migration
plan.transfer_review: original categories, anchor directions, prevalence, distances, margins, country problems, missingness

uncertainty.interpretation: variation over the observed held-out countries; not worldwide population or fitting uncertainty
uncertainty.within_country: preserve relative survey weights among complete cases

plan.weights: WGT normalized within complete-case country, equal country totals within each reporting area

publication_note: T5-only public view; full original provenance remains in the private course archive.
